preconditions.description: Number of test cases is between 1 and 1000.
Number of towns in each test case is between 1 and 40000.

preconditions.expression: for i in range(t): for j in range(n[i]): 1 <= b[i][j] <= 10**9
preconditions.description: Total duration of concerts in each town is between 1 and 10^9.

postconditions.expression: for i in range(t): if result[i] == 'NO': continue; else: len(result[i]) == n[i] and all(1 <= a <= 10**9 for a in result[i])

postconditions.description: The total duration of concerts in each town matches the given durations.
